pages.text: $(bold)Venus: The Acid World$()$(br)Mobs: $(bold){{dim ad_astra:venus difficulty}}$() the vanilla strength, like every Tier 4 world$(br)Death penalty: $(bold){{dim ad_astra:venus death}}$()$(br2)The most hostile inner planet. Crushing pressure and an acid atmosphere wear you down every moment you spend on the surface, and the mobs here are pressure-adapted and acid-resistant.

$(bold)Environmental Hazards$()$(br)• $(bold)Acid rain$() deals continuous damage everywhere on the surface$(br)• $(bold)Crushing pressure$() slows your movement a lot$(br)• Acid-resistant mobs gain Resistance and Strength$(br2)Venus is designed for short, intense trips: get in, mine what you need and get out. Long stays drain your resources fast.

$(bold)Purpose$()$(br)Venus has the high-value ores the $(bold)Tier 4 Rocket$() needs to reach Glacio, the endgame destination.$(br2)$(bold)Structures$()$(br)Floating cloud structures above the acid layer and deep surface bunkers hold unique loot. The floating ones are safer to explore but harder to reach.

$(bold)Planetary Rock Extraction$()$(br)Crush $(bold)Venus Stone$() in Create Crushing Wheels or a Thermal Pulverizer to extract:$(br)• $(bold)Sulfuric Compound$() (25%): corrosion-resistant alloys$(br)• $(bold)Pressure Crystal$() (15%): pressure-resistant tech$(br)• Quartz (40%)

$(bold)Pressure Shell Enchantment$()$(br)Venus mobs have a $(bold)12% chance$() to drop an enchanted book of $(bold)Pressure Shell$() (max level 2). On armor, it:$(br)• Reduces acid damage by 50% per level$(br)• Fully negates acid rain and pressure slowdown at level 2$(br)• Turns Venus from lethal into manageable$(br2)$(italic)Without Pressure Shell, keep your Venus trips very short.$()
